title: Slice Defense Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 130bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
They are driving the ball low
Defend with under spin
Slice the ball back deep
Float it slow and high

[Whisper verse]
Feet step back one stride
Knees bend low absorb
Paddle high above the ball
Grip pressure four out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Waist height window
High to low swing path
Face open thirty five up

[Tribal drop chant]
Slice it back slice it back
Float and deep float and deep
Vamos suave pa lante
Slice it back slice it back

[Whisper verse]
Landing zone deep middle
Under spin floats the ball
Slow pace high arc
Time to recover position

Follow through low and forward
Return to ready balanced
Reset the line move forward
Breath out and reset eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Slice it back slice it back
Float and deep float and deep
Vamos suave pa lante
Slice it back slice it back

[Whisper outro]
High to low
Float it deep
High to low
Float it deep
